title: local-env source manifest
description: local-env.yml at the root of a source repo: its name, its label and the accounts it needs (https://cgaube.github.io/local-env/write-a-source/source-repo).

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. local-env ignores it.

name.description: The name of the source on every Mac: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Unique: local-env skips a repo whose name is already added. Other sources name yours by it (acme-platform/postgres).

label.description: What the dashboard and the CLI show for the source, in place of its name. Free text.

logins.description: The accounts that the templates and the tools of the source need, by login name.

secrets.description: Where the values of the secrets of the source are, by the name of the variable each one fills: an input of a role of the source (meta/argument_specs.yml) or a name its local-env.yml asks for, or a variable of a compose file of the source (${NAME}). local-env reads a secret only when a tool it installs or a stack it deploys needs it, with the login's CLI and the user's own session.

type.description: registry: a registry of private images, for the templates. aws: an AWS account, for the AWS CLI in roles (Secrets Manager). vault: a HashiCorp Vault, for the vault CLI in roles.

registry.description: A registry of private images. local-env asks the user for a username and a token, which Dockhand keeps. For a registry whose tokens expire (AWS ECR), login names a login that gets them: local-env saves a new token in Dockhand with its session.

host.description: The registry host: ghcr.io. A path (ghcr.io/team) is the same login: Docker keeps one login for each host.

usernameHelp.description: Shown when local-env asks for the username: what to give.

tokenHelp.description: Shown when local-env asks for the token: what to give, and where to get it.

login.description: The login whose session gets the tokens, by name, or <source>/<name> for a login of another source. Today an aws login, for an ECR host (<account>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com). local-env asks for nothing and saves a new token in Dockhand on start, sources sync, deploy, install, update and local-env login.

aws.description: An AWS account. With sso, local-env writes the profile local-env-<source>-<login> in ~/.aws/config and runs `aws sso login`. Roles get its environment in local_env_logins.<login>.env.

sso.description: The IAM Identity Center account and role. One browser login covers every account of a start URL.

region.description: The region of the Identity Center

accountId.description: The 12 digits of the account. Quote it: '012345678901'.

profile.description: Without sso: a profile the user set up (credential_process, aws-vault). local-env writes nothing and cannot log in to it.

region.description: The region of the calls (AWS_REGION). Default: the region of sso.

help.description: Shown when the user is not logged in: who to ask for access.

vault.description: A HashiCorp Vault. local-env runs `vault login` and gives VAULT_ADDR (and VAULT_NAMESPACE) to the CLI and to the roles, in local_env_logins.<login>.env.

address.description: The URL of the Vault: https://vault.acme.io

method.description: The auth method of `vault login`: oidc by default

mount.description: The path of the auth method, when it is not the default one

role.description: The role of the auth method (oidc, jwt)

help.description: Shown when the user is not logged in: who to ask for access.

login.description: The login that reaches the vault: a login of this manifest, or <source>/<login>. An aws or vault login.

ref.description: The secret in that vault: an AWS secret name or ARN, or the path of a Vault KV entry (secret/github).

field.description: The key to take: of the secret's JSON value (AWS; without it, the whole text), or of the KV entry (Vault: required).
